create_adaptive_mask: create an AdaptiveMask module with a given max_size, ramp_size, and init_val for soft masking
apply_adaptive_mask_forward: apply the AdaptiveMask forward pass to mask out the last K values of a tensor input
create_adaptive_span: create an AdaptiveSpan module to learn attention span length for each self-attention head
apply_adaptive_span_forward: apply the AdaptiveSpan forward pass to mask and normalize attention weights across attention heads
trim_memory_with_adaptive_span: trim key, value, and key_pe memory tensors using AdaptiveSpan to reduce computation
